tickets.title: [P1] fix: real --help/-h/help (exit 0, stdout) + per-command help
tickets.body: Introduce a structured COMMANDS table (name, args, one-liner, extended help, flags) in bin/agb.mjs as the single source for dispatch + help. `agb`, `agb --help`, `agb -h`, `agb help` -> full usage on stdout, exit 0. `agb help <cmd>` and `agb <cmd> --help` -> per-command help, exit 0. Unknown command -> short usage + 'unknown command X' on stderr, exit 1.
